findings.passage: This bill is disguised as an effort to protect voter integrity and security but, in reality, it is designed to drive down voter turnout and make it harder and more complicated for Pennsylvanians to cast their vote.
findings.note: Statement in his name on H.B. 1300 (2021), a bill whose provisions, per his statement, included a special ID to cast a ballot, fewer drop boxes and ending mail voting. He says he will fight the bill.
